story.system.typing.text: The Lattice is down and the computers are silent. Commander, the console is yours: enter the codes by hand.
story.system.addition.text: The Static is hitting our colonies one after another. Add up their codes and break their shields.
story.system.subtraction.text: We have lost half our power. Every shot has to land, so subtract with care.
story.system.multiplication.text: They come in formations now. Multiplying is the only way to work them out in time.
story.system.division.text: The admiral's flagship has dropped off the scope. Her last signal divides across these sectors.
story.system.negatives.text: We are below zero, Commander. Numbers go negative here, and the Static knows it.
story.system.missing.text: You found me. Our own master beacon is what draws the Static. One part of the equation is still missing.
story.system.mixed.text: This is it. Retune the master beacon. You will need everything you have learned.
story.result.win: The beacon burns brighter. Good work, Commander.
story.result.lose: We are pulling back. We will return better prepared.
story.call.defend.1: {planet} is under attack. They need you, Commander.
story.call.defend.2: The Static is back at {planet}. Hurry.
story.call.defend.3: The beacon on {planet} is fading. Defend it.
story.call.liberate.1: The Static holds {planet}. Time to take it back.
story.call.liberate.3: {planet} is still silent. Light its beacon.
story.call.patrol.2: {planet} asks for an escort. Short job.
